channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ron Holland | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ron Holland from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Cade Cunningham on Jordan Clarkson, Ron Holland
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:Cade Cunningham on Ron Holland's ejection after confronting Jordan Clarkson with fists up:

“That’s who Ron is. Ron is a super loyal dude, super tough-minded dude. I could’ve had my eyes closed and guessed who was going to be in the middle of it. That’s just who he is.”

Cade Cunningham on Jordan Clarkson, Ron Holland, Dec 19, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Ron Holland
item.description:
James Edwards III:Trajan Langdon on Ron Holland:

“When thinking about Ron, and scouting Ron, watching a lot of tape, Ron embodies a lot what we want our players to be about here-- high character, extremely competitive, comes from a great family.”

Trajan Langdon on Ron Holland, Jun 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Fred Vinson, Ron Holland
item.description:
James Edwards III:Trajan Langdon on Ron Holland:

“He has one of the highest upsides in the draft... We hired Fred Vinson for a reason, to take chances. If his shot hits, he's going to be a real player.”

Trajan Langdon on Fred Vinson, Ron Holland, Jun 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.
